titles.zh-CN: Ansys MCP 与 Maxwell 工作流

equation: Common terminal voltage and total RMS current

tutorial_instructions.en: Run resource preflight; execute the native seven-strand MCP example when Maxwell is available.
tutorial_instructions.zh-CN: 执行资源预检；Maxwell 可用时运行原生七股 MCP 案例。

fixed_conventions: SI; exp(+j omega t); RMS; sigma=58 MS/m; mu_r=1; 20 C

en: This Notebook performs the resource preflight. The complete MCP case starts an owned Student gRPC Desktop, connects the upstream server, constructs seven voltage windings and a controlled return, and solves two linear bases plus a constrained final case.

AEDT voltage inputs are peak values; the adapter converts RMS inputs by √2 and reconstructs RMS complex currents and power. Maxwell CPython/PyAEDT execution differs from the embedded AEDT RunScript environment.

Inspect actual units, axial model depth, frequency, project contents, mesh statistics, complex strand currents and input/loss balance. A one-pass Student mesh supports only the explicitly reported comparison scope.
zh-CN: 本 Notebook 执行资源预检。完整 MCP 案例启动所属 Student gRPC Desktop，连接官方服务，构建七个电压绕组和受控回流，求解两个线性基工况与最终受约束工况。
AEDT 电压输入为峰值；适配层把 RMS 输入乘 √2，并重构 RMS 复电流及功率。CPython/PyAEDT 执行环境与 AEDT 内置 RunScript 不同。
检查实际单位、轴向模型深度、频率、工程内容、网格、复电流及输入损耗平衡；单遍 Student 网格仅支持明示的比较范围。
